renderer: make_fig_kcurve.py (hand-written matplotlib on the aii-data-fig-gen house style; the catalogue 'line' type only draws symmetric ± bands and no reference line)

source.population: development set E, candidates with all 7 other LLM vendor families available: n = 2014 candidates (1309 ERROR / 705 CORRECT) from 186 sentences
source.draw_procedure: for each k, 50 reproducible random k-subsets of each candidate's 7 other families; the line is the mean pooled AUROC over the 50 draws
source.band: 2.5th-97.5th percentile of pooled AUROC across the 50 draws (zero width at k = 7, where only one subset exists)
source.sentence_bootstrap_ci_of_draw_mean: ci_lo/ci_hi columns; reported in the caption, not drawn
source.words_tercile_rule: T3 = sentences with more than 26 words (cut points 20 and 26 words = 1/3 and 2/3 quantiles of sentence length, prereg_mech.json)

title: Consensus AUROC vs number of peer families
